title: Synthetic Medical Data Generation Suite
summary: A full-stack platform that generates privacy-safe synthetic medical data across imaging, clinical tabular, genomic, and time-series modalities, exposing pipelines through a Flask API and React console with quantitative fidelity evaluation. It trains SDV's TVAESynthesizer for genomic data generation and uses SDV Quality/Diagnostic Reports and CopulaGAN for tabular fidelity evaluation.
